"''Roger roger.|This droid speaking to the rest of the squadron.|{{TCW|Ambush}}}} A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and participated in the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Battle of Rugosa]]. ==History== During the battle, this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was part of a reinforcement [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] tasked with finding [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] along with three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Death/Legends|eliminating]] them before they reached their destination. As the droids advanced, they hit an impenetrable obstacle, a giant [[Tree/Legends|tree]] blocking the road, and were forced to continue on [[Limb/Legends|foot]]. As the droids were making their way through the [[Forest/Legends|forest]], this droid noticed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and ordered the rest of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to split up into [[Squad/Legends|squads]]. The droid was eventually killed by Yoda along with the other droids. ==Behind the scenes== This battle droid was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]], the actor who voices all the battle droids in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Ambush}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
